newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down, seen falling further.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down, seen falling further.

text.p: Pakistani stocks fell on Tuesday amid uncertainty about political and economic outlook, and dealers said the index could ease further on Wednesday.
"Lack of positive news in the market has pulled down the index," dealer Ali Asghar at Fortune Securities said, adding that the sentiment could remain bearish.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 7.35 points, or 0.53 percent, to end at 1,379.60 after dropping to 1,376.33 at noon. Losers led gainers 139 to 76. Turnover rose to 23.20 million shares from 22.82 million on Monday.

Muslim Commercial Bank fell 0.25 to 34 rupees and Adamjee Insurance 0.25 to 83.75. Pakland Cement fell 0.50 to 12.75, Hub Power Co 0.10 to 31.70, Sui Northern Gas 0.55 to 37.25 and Pakistan State Oil 7.0 to 322. PTCL fell 0.55 to 31.70 and ICI Pakistan 0.85 to 15.80.
